description.value: The Whistler Visitor Centre is Tourism Whistler's official in-resort information office, located at 4230 Gateway Drive beside the village bus and taxi loop. Staff help visitors with accommodation bookings, Whistler Transit schedules, activity planning, and BC-wide travel information, and a mobile live chat service extends that assistance beyond the building. Touring cyclists will find it a practical first stop for free maps, local insider knowledge, and transit connections into or out of the valley.
